subject: Tiếng Anh
title: Đề ôn cuối học kì 2 – Tiếng Anh 10 (đề số 1)
scope: Global Success 10: Unit 6 Gender equality; Unit 7 Viet Nam and international organisations; Unit 8 New ways to learn; trọng tâm Unit 9 Protecting the environment và Unit 10 Ecotourism (ngữ pháp: câu tường thuật, câu điều kiện loại 1 – 2; ôn bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu, so sánh, mệnh đề quan hệ)

questions.stem: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explanation: “local” /ˈləʊkl/ có “o” đọc /əʊ/; “protect”, “pollution”, “control” có “o” đọc /ə/.

questions.stem: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explanation: “animals” tận cùng âm hữu thanh /l/ → “-s” đọc /z/; “tourists”, “habitats”, “forests” tận cùng /t/ → đọc /s/.

questions.stem: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explanation: “pollute” /pəˈluːt/ nhấn âm 2; “tourism”, “travel”, “nature” nhấn âm 1.

questions.stem: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explanation: “habitat” /ˈhæbɪtæt/ nhấn âm 1; “pollution”, “protection”, “important” nhấn âm 2.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Women should not be ______ against when they apply for jobs.
questions.explanation: Bị động “be discriminated against” = bị phân biệt đối xử.

questions.topic: Unit 7: Viet Nam and international organisations – Vocabulary
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The United Nations works to maintain international peace and ______.
questions.explanation: Sau “peace and” cần danh từ song song: security (an ninh).

questions.topic: Unit 8: New ways to learn – Vocabulary
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
______ learning combines traditional classroom lessons with online activities.
questions.explanation: “Blended learning” (học kết hợp) = kết hợp học trên lớp và học trực tuyến; “distance learning” là học từ xa.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Cutting down forests destroys the natural ______ of many wild animals.
questions.explanation: “natural habitat” = môi trường sống tự nhiên; “habits” = thói quen.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Factories must stop releasing chemicals that ______ rivers and lakes.
questions.explanation: Sau đại từ quan hệ “that” (làm chủ ngữ) cần động từ chia: pollute (làm ô nhiễm).

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Global warming is one of the most serious ______ problems today.
questions.explanation: Trước danh từ “problems” cần tính từ: environmental (thuộc về môi trường).

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
______ is a form of tourism that protects the environment and benefits local people.
questions.explanation: Du lịch sinh thái (ecotourism) là loại hình bảo vệ môi trường và mang lại lợi ích cho người dân địa phương.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The tour was a great ______: we learnt a lot about the local culture and wildlife.
questions.explanation: “a great experience” = một trải nghiệm tuyệt vời; experiment = thí nghiệm, expertise = chuyên môn.

questions.topic: Unit 6 – Grammar: Passive voice with modal verbs
questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Old batteries ______ properly, not thrown away with household waste.
questions.explanation: Pin cũ “được tái chế” → should + be + V3: should be recycled.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Ecotourism is becoming ______ popular among young people.
questions.explanation: So sánh lũy tiến với tính từ dài: more and more + adj (ngày càng…).

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Cuc Phuong, ______ is Viet Nam's first national park, attracts many ecotourists every year.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định thay cho địa danh làm chủ ngữ → which; “where” không làm chủ ngữ, không dùng “that” sau dấu phẩy.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
He said that he ______ to the eco-camp the following week.
questions.explanation: Động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ, “the following week” (← next week) → will lùi thành would.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The students told me that they ______ trees in their school garden at that moment.
questions.explanation: Lời nói trực tiếp ở hiện tại tiếp diễn (“now” → “at that moment”) → lùi thì thành quá khứ tiếp diễn: were planting.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
If we ______ water, we will save money and protect the environment.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, S + will + V → save.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
If I ______ rich, I would travel to all the national parks in the world.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2 (giả định trái hiện tại): If + quá khứ đơn (“to be” dùng were), S + would + V.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
If tourists ______ rubbish everywhere, the beaches would be much cleaner.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính “would be” → điều kiện loại 2, mệnh đề if dùng quá khứ đơn: didn't throw.

questions.stem:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Hoa: “Would you like to join our tree-planting activity this Sunday?”
Nam: “______”
options: I'd love to. What time does it start?
questions.explanation: Nhận lời mời “Would you like to…?” → “I'd love to.”

questions.stem:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Mai: “What do you think about ecotourism?”
Peter: “______”
options: In my opinion, it helps protect nature and supports local people.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi xin ý kiến → trả lời bằng quan điểm “In my opinion, …”.

questions.stem:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful conversation.
a. Mai: Where did you go?
b. Nam: I went to Cat Tien National Park with my family.
c. Mai: Did you have a nice weekend, Nam?
d. Nam: Yes, it was fantastic.
questions.explanation: Mai hỏi cuối tuần thế nào (c) → Nam trả lời (d) → Mai hỏi đã đi đâu (a) → Nam kể đi Cát Tiên (b).

questions.stem:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.
a. Firstly, the smoke causes air pollution, which harms people's health.
b. Therefore, people should sort their rubbish and recycle it instead.
c. Burning rubbish is common in many rural areas, but it is very harmful.
d. Secondly, it releases greenhouse gases that contribute to global warming.
questions.explanation: Câu chủ đề (c) → Firstly (a) → Secondly (d) → kết luận Therefore (b).

questions.stem:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Plastic is one of the most useful materials in the modern world. It is cheap, light and strong, so it is used to make almost everything, from bottles and bags to toys and computers. However, plastic has become a serious threat to the environment.

Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic waste end up in the oceans. Because plastic takes hundreds of years to break down, it stays in the environment for a very long time. Sea animals such as turtles and seabirds often mistake plastic bags for food. When they eat them, they may become sick or even die. In addition, plastic slowly breaks into tiny pieces called microplastics, which can enter the food chain and finally reach our dinner tables.

Many countries have taken action to solve this problem. Some have banned single-use plastic bags, while others charge customers for each bag they use. In Viet Nam, some supermarkets have started wrapping vegetables in banana leaves instead of plastic.

Individuals can also make a difference. We can carry reusable bags and bottles, say no to plastic straws, and recycle plastic products whenever possible. If each person makes small changes in their daily habits, together we can greatly reduce plastic pollution and protect our planet for future generations.

What is the passage mainly about?
options: Why plastic is cheap and useful
The problem of plastic pollution and ways to reduce it
questions.explanation: Bài nêu tác hại của rác nhựa và các giải pháp của quốc gia, cá nhân.

questions.stem:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
She told me (A) that she (B) would join (C) the clean-up campaign (D) tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Trong câu tường thuật (động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ, đã lùi “will” → “would”), “tomorrow” phải đổi thành “the next day/ the following day”.

questions.stem:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
If more people (A) chose ecotourism, nature (B) will be (C) better (D) protected.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề if ở quá khứ đơn (điều kiện loại 2) → mệnh đề chính dùng would + V: will be → would be.

questions.stem:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
“I am reading a book about endangered animals,” Lan said.
options: Lan said that she had read a book about endangered animals.
Lan said that she was reading a book about endangered animals.
Lan said that she is reading a book about endangered animals.
Lan said that I was reading a book about endangered animals.
questions.explanation: Đổi ngôi I → she, lùi thì hiện tại tiếp diễn → quá khứ tiếp diễn: was reading.

questions.stem:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
We don't have enough money, so we can't go on an eco-tour.
options: If we didn't have enough money, we could go on an eco-tour.
If we had enough money, we could go on an eco-tour.
If we have enough money, we can go on an eco-tour.
If we had had enough money, we could go on an eco-tour.
questions.explanation: Sự thật ở hiện tại (không đủ tiền) → giả định trái hiện tại bằng điều kiện loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn, S + could + V; đổi phủ định thành khẳng định.
